name: rul-estimator
description: Remaining-useful-life estimator for rotating machinery. Takes a recent history of health-index readings and fits an exponential degradation model — the same shape used in production PHM systems on turbine blades, pump bearings, and compressor valves.

analysis_notes.message: Seeded from industrial-iot/code-assets/rul-estimator

readings.description: Chronological history of health observations. Newest last.

failure_threshold.description: Health level below which the asset is considered failed.

rul_hours.description: Remaining useful life in hours. 0 if already below threshold.

confidence.description: 0..1 — R² of the fit vs. history.

trend_slope.description: Per-hour rate of health change (negative = degrading).

horizon_samples.description: How many readings were used for the fit.

name: wingman-var-simulator
description: Monte Carlo Value-at-Risk simulator for Wingman strategy rules. Takes a corridor + side + size + recent EIA weekly spot history, runs N GBM walks of P&L over the horizon, and emits p50/p95/p99 VaR, expected shortfall at p99, mean/std, and a 30-bucket histogram. Compute-heavy (10k sims × 30 days × 5 RNG draws / step) — ~5–10× faster than the same maths in NumPy at this scale.

analysis_notes.message: Seeded from wingman/code-assets/var-simulator

spot_history.description: Recent weekly EIA spot ($/gal). Used to fit GBM drift+vol.

n_simulations.description: Number of Monte Carlo paths. Typical: 10000.

freight_usd_mt.description: Bunker-derived freight cost USD/MT. Used in P&L attribution.

histogram.description: 30-bucket equal-width histogram of terminal P&L across paths.

expected_shortfall_p99_usd.description: Avg loss in worst 1% of paths

name: pump-dsp-correction
description: Vibration-signal DSP for rotating machinery. Takes a window of raw accelerometer samples, removes drift, de-noises, then computes the classic bearing / imbalance / misalignment / cavitation health indicators used by every real predictive-maintenance suite.

analysis_notes.message: Seeded from industrial-iot/code-assets/pump-dsp-correction

samples.description: Raw accelerometer samples in g (or any consistent unit).

sensor_id.description: Stable id of the sensor emitting the window.

shaft_rpm.description: Optional shaft RPM — if supplied, per-fault scores use it.

sample_rate_hz.description: Sampling rate in Hz. Typical industrial: 2000–25000.

peak.description: Peak absolute amplitude in the window.

crest_factor.description: peak / rms. Crest > 5 suggests impulsive faults (bearing).

dominant_freqs.description: Top-5 bins from the FFT, sorted by amplitude desc.

iso_10816_zone.description: A/B/C/D per ISO 10816-3 severity (if shaft_rpm + RMS provided).

name: cold-chain-corrector
description: Cold-chain telemetry signal correction + excursion detection for reefer containers (pharma, fresh food, vaccines). Takes a window of noisy sensor readings and emits Kalman-smoothed temperature, dwell-time per stop, door-open events, and FSMA-style excursion flags.

analysis_notes.message: Seeded from industrial-iot/code-assets/cold-chain-corrector

excursion_minutes.description: Minutes outside spec before excursion flagged

smoothed.description: Kalman-smoothed temperature time series aligned to input.

excursions.description: Windows where temp was out-of-spec beyond excursion_minutes.
